title: Student Performance and Education Analytics
problem_statement: School leaders need to identify observable performance and attendance patterns so limited support resources can be targeted for further investigation.
questions: How do grades and absences vary by school?
What patterns appear across support programs?
Which groups need larger samples before action?
hypotheses: Higher study hours are associated with higher grades.
Support participation is associated with different pass rates.
recommendations: Target diagnostic interviews where absence and pass patterns diverge.
Evaluate support programs prospectively rather than treating observed associations as program effects.
